# Reporting a vulnerability

Oubliette holds copies of emails that staging sites send, and those often carry real names, addresses and links. A flaw in it can expose them, so please don't report one in a public issue.

Use the "Report a vulnerability" button in the [Security tab](../../security/advisories/new) instead. The report stays private between you and the maintainer until a fix is out.

Say which version you tested, what an attacker needs (network access to the SMTP port, a Share Link, a Member account), and the steps to reproduce. You'll get an answer within a week.

Only the latest release gets security fixes.
